theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → InjOn (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) (ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v)) ∧ IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, tangentSpace ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) = (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) : Set (Euclid (n + k)))
